title: Counting fan-in-two circuits
statement: Let $n,S$ be natural numbers with $1 \le n$, $1 \le S$, and $10nS \le 2^n$. The number of Boolean functions on $n$ inputs computed by well-formed fan-in-two directed acyclic circuits of size at most $S$ is at most $2^{n\cdot 2(S+1)}$, and $20n(S+1) \le 9\cdot 2^n$.
